description: Rest areas, state maintained (NSW, NT, QLD, SA, TAS, VIC, WA) is a group of 7 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by Asset Manager; Department for Infrastructure and Transport, SA; Department of Transport and Main Roads. Members: Rest Areas - State Maintained - NSW; Rest Areas - State Maintained - NT; Rest Areas - State Maintained - QLD; Rest Areas - State Maintained - SA; Rest Areas - State Maintained - Tas; Rest Areas - State Maintained - Vic; Rest Areas - State Maintained - WA. Example entry: Locations of the rest areas along the road network. It includes details such as the rest areas name, access direction, and the different facilities (e.g. toilets, fuel, BBQ facilities, etc.) that are available at each rest area. Coverage is Australia and its states and territories, 2017 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as infrequent, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-10-24. Files and pages listed: HTML (7 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (catalogue label "Creative Commons Attribution 4.1"); CC-BY-3.0-AU; CC-BY-4.0; other members not stated. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
